scope: Coherent throat with a frozen stationary crystalline reference. The primary transported-interior-order comparison includes both sides of the carrier and neutral order front and a continued outgoing symmetric-strain cavity pole at J=1. The shallow order controls relax the interior order with the spatial symmetric wave and through-flow at each signed offset, while omitting feedback of any added static elastic energy. The mechanical outer wall response and any extra radiation or order degree of freedom outside the cavity are separately modeled. Results are shape probes only. No radius 3.
